title: Operator Drops A Fact (No Question Back)
style: deep dub-techno, 110 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, low chord stab, vinyl crackle, single ride bell, taut male spoken word, professional dispatcher tone
lyrics:
[Intro]
static on the channel, line clear
operator says a thing, and I hear

[Verse 1]
no preamble, no big setup
just a fact in the empty cup
brother of a brother, name and link
logged before I have time to think

[Pre-Chorus]
the pact is simple, hard to break
file what's said, no embellish, no fake

[Chorus]
operator drops a fact
no question back, that's the pact
don't ask twice, don't ask why
just receive and let it lie
operator drops a fact
no question back, no question back

[Verse 2]
curiosity isn't the job
dossier creep would rob
the trust that the channel needs
so I plant only what's been seeded

[Chorus]
operator drops a fact
no question back, that's the pact
don't ask twice, don't ask why
just receive and let it lie
operator drops a fact
no question back, no question back

[Outro]
file closed, channel clear
next fact when it appears
